source: Casa-Libre Venezuela active listings (asking prices published on casa-libre.com.ve; not closing prices)
notes: Asking prices of listings published on Casa-Libre, not closing prices.
Medians and ranges only where at least 5 listings have a price; null = too few to say.
gross_rent_yield_pct = median monthly rent x 12 / median sale price, same city and type. A rough comparison of asking prices, not a return on investment.
A city is listed only with at least 15 active listings. Barrios or zones that listings store as the city are counted in their city (scripts/build-market.mjs, CITY_RULES).
USD prices are rounded: from USD 10,000 to the nearest 500, below that to the nearest 10. The price per m2 is rounded to the dollar.
Price statistics leave out obvious errors: sale prices under USD 1,000 and monthly rents outside USD 30 to 30,000 (they still count in the listing totals).
Every listing is priced in US dollars (price_usd). ves_per_usd = 911.62 is only a reference rate (open.er-api.com, 2026-11-13); any conversion to bolívares is approximate and moves fast: say so.
casa_libre_pages = Casa-Libre city pages that answered 200 to a GET when the snapshot was built; link only these (or the filtered search).
